about: Weekly Prep'Up reel pipeline. One video per Buffer slot, queued to TikTok, Instagram and Facebook. Every video gets a music combination (style + key) never used before.
lessons: 6-outils reel (2026-10-29): avg watch time 3 s of 31.5 s on TikTok and Instagram. Hooks must show motion or a number in the first second, never a text-only screen. Keep videos 15-22 s.
TikTok gets ~10x the views of Instagram: always include it.

videos.posted: 2026-10-29 by hand on all three channels

analytics.how: Before each new video: pull sent posts with metrics from Buffer, record them per video and platform, compare videos, then update 'lessons' and 'strategy'. Metrics refresh about daily: treat posts younger than 48 h as preliminary.
metrics_tracked: avg watch time (s) and % of video length

history.verdict: Reach OK on TikTok, but viewers leave at ~3 s (10% of the video). Text-only hook + 31.5 s length is the main problem. Zero comments: CTA never seen.

current: Hook = motion or a number on screen in the first second (never a text-only screen)
TikTok is the priority platform (10x Instagram views)
One tool per video, its most visual moment first
experiments_to_try: Compare avg watch time of the calculator reel (number hook, 21 s) against the 6-outils reel (text hook, 31.5 s)
Try a question in the caption's first line vs a statement
Try pinning a first comment with the CTA
changelog: 2026-11-09: switched from text hooks / 31.5 s to motion-or-number hooks / 15-22 s after 3 s avg watch time on the 6-outils reel
